description: Spot price of any ERC20 read straight from the deepest Uniswap V3 pool against USDC, on Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum or Optimism. Returns the pool address, fee tier, liquidity, sqrtPriceX96, tick and block, so the number can be audited instead of trusted. No aggregator and no API key: the source is the chain itself. Via eth_call. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

quote.description: Token to price it against. Defaults to the chain's native USDC.
